notes.text: The page is part of the Rethinking Pitt-Rivers project and is credited only as “AP, September 2011”; the initials are retained without expansion. It combines editorial discussion with excerpts and transcriptions of nineteenth-century writing about evolutionary sequence, cultural development and museum display. Historical racial and evolutionary language belongs to the quoted period material and is not a present-day endorsement by the project or the Pitt Rivers Museum. No local page capture is registered because redistribution rights for a preserved copy were not established during review.
